hero.geoSummary: Rusiru Rathmina is a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, building robust full-stack solutions for modern web applications. He specializes in developing high-performance web applications, RESTful APIs, and enterprise solutions using Java, Spring Boot, React, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

about.geoSummary: Rusiru Rathmina is a Software Engineer with professional experience spanning full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, application security, and DevOps. He works at Omobio (Pvt) Ltd in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and has contributed to enterprise platforms including Dialog.lk and Dialog BizCare for Dialog Axiata PLC. His expertise includes Java, Spring Boot, React.js, PHP, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC) with a GPA of 3.01.

paragraphs: 👋 Hello! I'm **Rusiru Rathmina**, a **Software Engineer** at ==Omobio (Pvt) Ltd==, specializing in **Full-Stack Development**, **Cloud Computing**, and **DevOps**.

My journey began as a trainee, and I have since grown into designing scalable solutions using **Java, Spring Boot, React, and AWS**. I have extensive hands-on experience refactoring legacy systems and building secure, reliable applications.
My expertise covers the full lifecycle—from frontend design with **React.js** to backend logic in **PHP/Drupal** and infrastructure management using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
🚀 I am always open to collaborating on ==Full-Stack== or ==DevOps== projects. Let's connect and shape the future of technology together!

experience.geoSummary: Rusiru Rathmina is a Software Engineer at Omobio (Pvt) Ltd in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Since January 2026, he has managed AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes infrastructure, migrated Dialog.lk container images from end-of-life Debian to Alpine Linux, reducing image sizes by 60% and deployment time by 75%, and contributed to ISO 27001 compliance and secure coding initiatives. experience.title: Work Experience

description: Managed and supported cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, and orchestration workflows using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes (K8s).

Successfully migrated Dialog.lk application images from end-of-life (EOL) Debian to Alpine Linux, reducing container image sizes by 60% and deployment time by 75%. Modernized legacy image build processes by implementing multi-stage builds to improve build efficiency, reduce image footprint, and strengthen security.
Implemented secure coding practices and contributed to application security initiatives aligned with OWASP best practices and ISO 27001 requirements.
Strengthened container and base image security by identifying and remediating CVE vulnerabilities, improving the overall security posture of applications and infrastructure.
Represented the development team in ISO 27001 compliance activities, security audits, and related processes, supporting adherence to organizational security standards.
Conducted peer code reviews and mentored new team members, promoting engineering best practices, code quality, and team productivity.

Served as a key software engineer for the Dialog.lk platform, while independently managing Level 3 (L3) production support, ensuring application stability, service continuity, and timely incident resolution.
Investigated and resolved complex production issues, performed root cause analysis, and optimized application performance to improve system reliability and availability.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to develop, maintain, and deliver scalable, high-quality, enterprise-grade software solutions.
Contributed to CI/CD pipeline management, release coordination, and DevOps initiatives, streamlining development workflows and improving deployment efficiency.
Gained hands-on experience in full-stack development using React.js, Node.js, and PHP, contributing to the development and maintenance of enterprise-level applications.
Provided Level 3 (L3) production support for the Dialog.lk and Dialog BizCare platforms, troubleshooting technical issues and supporting application stability.
Investigated and resolved software defects and production incidents across Dialog.lk and Dialog BizCare, helping minimize service disruptions and maintain operational continuity.
Analyzed application and system issues through server log analysis, service debugging, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.

Participated in requirements gathering, solution planning, and system design for a tea factory production automation system, contributing to the development of solutions aimed at improving operational efficiency.

projects.geoSummary: Rusiru Rathmina has worked on 8 notable projects: Dialog.lk, an enterprise CMS platform for Dialog Axiata; Dialog BizCare, a corporate customer management portal; MockDeck, an API mocking and integration testing platform; Jira Worklog Manager, a productivity tool for Jira Cloud worklogs; Project-X, a produce collection automation system; Roamly, a travel recommendation platform; Micro CAPS, an assembly process management system; and ToDo, a Flutter-based task manager.
projects.title: Featured Projects

items.title: Dialog.lk
description: Played a key role in the development, maintenance, and production support of the Dialog.lk platform, handling complex L3 incidents, root cause analysis, and performance optimization while ensuring SLA compliance and meeting critical deadlines.

Led efforts to refactor the legacy codebase in alignment with OWASP Top 10 security best practices, integrating SonarQube to improve code quality, identify vulnerabilities, and strengthen secure development practices.

Developed custom Drupal modules integrating Amazon SES to replace SMTP-based email delivery, improving security and deliverability, and implemented user consent management capabilities to support compliance with Sri Lanka’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

Identified and remediated security hotspots, code vulnerabilities, and CVE-related issues across the application and container images, strengthening the overall security posture and supporting ISO 27001 compliance activities.

Migrated Dialog.lk application container images from end-of-life Debian to Alpine Linux, achieving a 60% reduction in image size and a 75% improvement in deployment time. Modernized legacy image build processes using multi-stage builds to improve efficiency and security.
Optimized application performance and scalability using AWS services, including S3, SES, and CloudWatch, alongside caching mechanisms to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
Contributed to CI/CD pipeline management, release coordination, and DevOps initiatives, supporting reliable deployments and streamlined development workflows.

items.title: Dialog BizCare
description: Acted as a Level 3 (L3) support engineer, fixing bugs and handling live production issues within defined SLAs.
Investigated production issues by analyzing server logs and implemented effective solutions to ensure system stability.
Collaborated directly with clients and end-users to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues efficiently.
Worked closely with senior engineers while following Agile development methodologies, coding standards, and software engineering best practices.

items.title: MockDeck — API Mocking & Integration Testing Platform
description: Designed and developed MockDeck, an API mocking platform that helps developers and QA teams simulate API behavior, test integrations, and reproduce failure scenarios without depending on live backend services.
The platform supports exact-request matching, configurable responses, dynamic JSON templates, callback simulation, environment variables, and Postman collection imports.
Designed the application architecture and developed the backend, dashboard, and API mocking workflows.
Implemented configurable request matching, weighted responses, sequential responses, rule-based selection, and fault simulation.
Built dynamic response templates, callback configuration, request/callback logs, and version history with comparison and restoration.
Developed import/export workflows with previews, variable mapping, credential detection, and sensitive-data masking.
Added Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for automated mock management and Postman imports, including isolated test runs and safe retries.
Created automated backend and frontend regression tests, CI checks, and technical documentation.

items.title: Jira Worklog Manager
description: Built a browser-based personal productivity tool for logging and managing Jira Cloud worklogs, eliminating the friction of Jira's native time-tracking UI with a fast, keyboard-first single-page experience.

Designed and implemented a proxy-free React + Vite architecture with a custom month-bucket worklog cache, enabling on-demand data fetching per view instead of a single upfront bulk load — reducing initial API calls significantly.

Engineered a real-time work timer that persists across page reloads and browser restarts using localStorage, with a floating chip that survives client-side navigation and pre-fills the log work modal on stop.

Implemented advanced worklog operations including bulk logging across multiple issues, worklog splitting with live sum validation, duplicate entry, and a 5-second undo-delete flow with optimistic UI updates.

Built a multi-tab summary dashboard featuring a Clockwork-style weekly timesheet grid, GitHub-style heatmap calendar, per-project breakdown chart, logged vs. estimated variance report, and CSV export.
Developed a per-issue work notes system backed by the File System Access API for auto-save to a user-chosen file on disk, with graceful fallback to manual export/import on unsupported browsers.
Implemented a global command palette with fuzzy issue search, keyboard navigation, and direct Jira key lookup, along with Jira workflow status transitions directly from the issue list.

items.title: Project-X

Implemented storage, customer, and supplier management modules using an MVC-based architecture.
Built a modern frontend using React and integrated a CMS-based backend.
